high_level_description: This image depicts an outdoor balcony or terrace area of a building. The floor is covered with blue tiles that have a white geometric pattern, arranged in a grid-like design. The tiles are bordered by a decorative trim featuring a repeating pattern of small, intricate designs. The balcony has a glass railing on one side, which provides a clear view of the surrounding greenery, including trees and foliage. The railing appears to be modern and sleek, with a transparent glass panel supported by metal frames.
